description: This file is a C++ header defining utilities related to vendor message processing, including functions for extracting data from payloads and parsing vendor-specific TLV messages, as well as external references such as vendor OUI list and message classes.

methods.name: extract_uint8
methods.description: Extracts an 8-bit unsigned integer from the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: extract_uint16
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: parse_vendor_message_type
methods.description: Parses vendor-specific TLV message and populates vendor vector and OUI list for each vendor.
